projects.name: Ellendale HPC Campus 100 MW HPC facility
projects.quote: During the prior fiscal year, the Company broke ground on its first 100 MW HPC facility in Ellendale, North Dakota.

projects.name: Ellendale HPC Campus two additional buildings
projects.quote: Beyond this, we plan to bring an additional 300 MW online through two additional buildings, which are in the design stage, ultimately increasing Ellendale's total HPC capacity to 400 MW.

projects.name: Cloud Services Business GPU clusters
projects.quote: The Company added two additional clusters to our Cloud Services Business, increasing the total to six clusters, each containing 1,024 GPUs.

projects.name: Jamestown, North Dakota 106 MW facility
projects.quote: As of August 31, 2024, our 106 MW facility in Jamestown, North Dakota and our 180 MW facility in Ellendale, North Dakota are operating at full capacity.
